name: GTT Data Solutions Limited
summary: GTT Data Solutions Limited, founded in 1986 and headquartered in Pune, India, offers specialized services globally and within India to the manufacturing, industrial products, and medical devices technology sectors. The company’s primary objective is to facilitate the development and construction of new products, optimize processes, and build essential infrastructure for these industries. Its operations are structured into two distinct segments: IT Services and Training. The IT Services division provides a wide array of AI solutions and digital engineering expertise, including strategic consulting, digital transformation initiatives, data engineering, advanced analytics, enterprise-level AI implementation, DevOps/IT service management, comprehensive ERP/CRM solutions, and various managed or outsourced services. Concurrently, the Training segment focuses on cultivating human intelligence and workforce development. This includes fostering skills in AI model development, data science, cloud technologies, software development and testing, and ERP systems. Additionally, it promotes human-digital collaboration, develops leadership capabilities for the AI era, drives organizational culture change, and prepares talent with dual intelligence readiness. The company was formerly known as Cinerad Communications Limited, officially changing its name to GTT Data Solutions Limited in January 2025.
